binding_note: The identifying route runs message → reaction → reacting user → that user's workspace-membership record → workspace: the reactor's admin role must be the role recorded on their (single) membership in Test Workspace itself, not a plain member role in that same workspace.

obligations.name: admin_thumbsup_messages
obligations.description: Messages that received a 👍 reaction from a user whose workspace-membership record in Test Workspace shows role=admin; no such message exists given the seeded reactions.
obligations.scope: messages across all channels in Test Workspace bearing a 👍 reaction from a Test-Workspace-admin reactor

task_spec.text: Identify which messages carry a 👍 reaction from a user holding an admin role in Test Workspace, and report any found.

access_plan: Enumerate channels via conversations.list, pull message history with conversations.history, and inspect per-message reactions with reactions.get to find all 👍 reactions; for each reacting user, call users.info to read their workspace-membership role — since every queried user here holds exactly one workspace membership (in Test Workspace), users.info's single reported workspace association unambiguously gives the role to check (admin vs. member) without needing any unsupported team-scoping parameter.
